summary: Backend testing complete - All 60 tests passed (50 existing + 10 new lineup algorithm tests). Comprehensive testing of upgraded lineup algorithm with position-based balancing, auto 3rd team activation for friendly matches, league constraint enforcement, and result recording for 3-team matches.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ _build_lineup buckets yes-voters by preferred_position (GK/DEF/MID/FWD/ANY - null maps to ANY)
✅ Each position bucket sorted by rating descending for skill distribution
✅ Players assigned to team with fewest players, tie-break by lowest total team rating
✅ Position distribution balanced: with 2 GK, 3 DEF, 3 MID, 2 FWD across 2 teams, each position differs by ≤1 player
✅ Auto 3rd team activation: len(yes_voters) >= team_size * 3 AND match_type != 'league'
✅ Friendly match with 15 yes voters (team_size=5) auto-enables 3 teams (5+5+5)
✅ League match with 15+ yes voters stays 2 teams (5+5+5 reserves) - league constraint enforced
✅ third_team_enabled=true persisted to match document when auto-bump occurs (lines 559-560)
✅ Subsequent GET /api/matches/{id} returns third_team_enabled=true after auto-bump
✅ League match does NOT flip third_team_enabled even with 20+ yes voters
✅ Rating balance: algorithm distributes by position first, then rating (structure verified)
✅ Explicit 'reserve' vote always lands in reserves regardless of team capacity
✅ Overflow yes voters beyond num_teams * team_size go to reserves (16 yes with 5v5 3-team → 15 on teams + 1 reserve)
✅ Lineup generation is idempotent: calling generate-lineup twice yields same team compositions
✅ Result recording on auto-3rd-team match accepts team_c_score and updates all 3 teams' participants
✅ All 12 players in auto-3rd-team match have matches_played incremented
✅ Player stats (goals, assists) correctly recorded and rating computed (goals*3 + assists*2 + matches*1)
✅ No regressions: all 50 existing tests still pass (auth, forgot-password, users, config, matches, league features)
seed_data_creation: Tests create unique users per test run using timestamp-based email addresses (TEST_*_{timestamp}@clubdodo.com). Admin user (admin@clubdodo.com / dodo2026) is seeded on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lineup algorithm upgraded to balance by BOTH position AND rating. Algorithm buckets yes-voters by preferred_position (GK/DEF/MID/FWD/ANY), sorts each bucket by rating desc, then assigns to team with fewest players (tie-break by lowest total rating). Auto 3rd team activation when yes-voters >= 3*team_size AND match_type != 'league' (league stays 2-team). third_team_enabled flag persisted to match document when auto-bump occurs. Result recording handles team_c_score and updates all 3 teams' participants. All existing functionality intact (no regressions).

lineup_algorithm_new: Position-based balancing: 10 players (2 GK, 3 DEF, 3 MID, 2 FWD) distributed across 2 teams with each position balanced within 1 player
Auto 3rd team: 15 yes voters (3*team_size) in friendly match auto-enables 3 teams (5+5+5)
League constraint: 15 yes voters in league match stays 2 teams (5+5+5 reserves)
Persistence: third_team_enabled=true persisted to match document after auto-bump, verified via GET
League no auto-bump: 20 yes voters in league match does NOT flip third_team_enabled
Rating balance: algorithm structure verified (position-first, then rating tie-break)
Reserve vote: explicit 'reserve' vote always lands in reserves (2 reserve voters confirmed in reserves)
Overflow reserves: 16 yes voters with 5v5 3-team → 15 on teams + 1 in reserves
Idempotency: calling generate-lineup twice yields identical team compositions (same user_ids in each team)
Result recording: auto-3rd-team match accepts team_c_score, updates all 12 players' matches_played, records goals/assists/rating
auth: POST /api/auth/login - admin login returns admin role
GET /api/auth/me - with Bearer token returns user
POST /api/auth/forgot-password - with existing email returns {ok: true, dev_code: '6-digit', message}
POST /api/auth/forgot-password - with unknown email returns {ok: true, dev_code: null, message}
POST /api/auth/reset-password - with correct code succeeds and changes password
POST /api/auth/reset-password - old password fails, new password works after reset
POST /api/auth/reset-password - with wrong code returns 400 'Invalid code'
POST /api/auth/reset-password - without prior forgot-password returns 400 'No reset code has been requested'
POST /api/auth/reset-password - validates password length (min 6 chars, returns 422)
POST /api/auth/forgot-password - requesting new code deletes prior pending tokens
users: GET /api/users - lists users sorted by rating desc
PUT /api/users/me - updates name, shirt_number, profile_picture, preferred_position
config: PUT /api/config - admin only, updates club_name and club_logo
matches: POST /api/matches - any authenticated user can create
GET /api/matches/{id} - returns match with votes array
POST /api/matches/{id}/generate-lineup - editor only, position+rating balanced lineup
POST /api/matches/{id}/result - editor only, updates stats and rating
league_features: POST /api/auth/register - without preferred_position defaults to None
GET /api/auth/me - returns new league fields (preferred_position, wins, draws, losses, league_points)
POST /api/matches - defaults to match_type='friendly' and third_team_enabled=false
POST /api/matches/{id}/generate-lineup - with third_team_enabled=false produces empty team_c
POST /api/matches/{id}/result - league match awards league points (winner +3, loser 0, draw +1 each)
POST /api/matches/{id}/result - league match draw awards 1 point each
POST /api/matches/{id}/result - friendly match does NOT award league points
POST /api/matches/{id}/result - editing league match reverts prior league points
DELETE /api/matches/{id} - deleting league match reverts league points
POST /api/matches/{id}/result - 3-team match increments matches_played for all 3 teams
POST /api/matches/{id}/result - 3-team league match does NOT award league points

verified_requirements: ✅ _build_lineup with 2*team_size yes voters and mixed positions produces 2 teams with evenly distributed positions (each team has similar GK/DEF/MID/FWD counts within 1)
✅ _build_lineup with 3*team_size yes voters in a FRIENDLY match auto-enables 3rd team (returns third_team_enabled=true with team_c populated)
✅ _build_lineup with 3*team_size yes voters in a LEAGUE match STAYS 2 teams (third_team_enabled=false; remaining voters go to reserves)
✅ POST /api/matches/{id}/generate-lineup on a match with sufficient friendly yes votes persists third_team_enabled=true on the match document so subsequent GETs include 3-team info
✅ POST /api/matches/{id}/generate-lineup on a league match does NOT flip third_team_enabled even with many yes voters
✅ Rating balance across teams is reasonable (algorithm structure verified - position-first distribution with rating tie-break)
✅ Explicit 'reserve' vote still always lands in reserves regardless of capacity
✅ Overflow yes voters beyond num_teams * team_size go to reserves (e.g., 16 yes with 5v5 3-team → 15 on teams + 1 reserve)
✅ Previous lineup can be regenerated (idempotent) - calling generate-lineup twice yields same team compositions
✅ No regressions - all previous 50 tests still pass (auth, forgot-password, matches, users, config, vote, league points, delete)
✅ Result recording on an auto-3rd-team match works: accepts team_c_score, updates stats for all 3 teams' participants
